purpose: measured lattice-update throughput used by the anchor-Re reachability design (task ③); raw measurement, not derived
note: raw kernel throughput only (collide+stream on resident arrays, no wall model, no force observers, no sponge, no I/O) — an UPPER BOUND for whole-solver throughput
selection_rule: D3Q19 + MRT at the largest measured 3D configuration that is not truncated in z (64x64x64) — matches the production lattice/collision pair of the anchor-Re protocol (gci_v4.json::ladder_protocol)
caveat: measured with the shared node under external load (load 39.72) and torch default threading (64 of 128 cores); a dedicated run may be faster, so hours computed from this number are conservative in the optimistic direction
